verdict.rationale: The schedule half of the story is documented: connections refresh nightly at a time you can change, you can trigger or stop a sync on demand, and you can re-import past months after fixing them in the books. The model is described as "rebuilt overnight off the close." Nothing in the evidence shows each connected source displaying a last-synced timestamp, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: a per-source last-synced indicator, detailed refresh-schedule documentation tied to the close, and independent or hands-on verification.
